title: Capstone: Config File Parser
description:
```ini
[window]
width = 1280
fullscreen = true
title = "My Game"
[audio]
volume = 0.75
```
```cpp
Config cfg{ Config::load("settings.ini") };
int w{ cfg.get<int>("window.width") };
auto vol{ cfg.getOr<double>("audio.volume", 1.0) };
```
requirements: Parse sections, keys, quoted strings, comments (`;`, `#`)
`get<T>` template with specializations/`if constexpr` for `int`, `double`, `bool`, `std::string`, `std::vector<T>` (`a, b, c`)
`set<T>` + `save()` writing the file back (strong guarantee: write to temp file, then rename)
